assets.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: transparent cutout for the right-hand artwork area of a desktop automotive Import service banner.
Input images: Image 1 is an identity reference for the black Mercedes-Benz G-Class, including its boxy body, black finish and realistic vehicle detailing. Image 2 is a style reference for the existing isolated front-facing Audi service composition; match its realistic studio cutout look, crisp edges and subordinate logistics details.
Primary request: a new premium photorealistic black G-Class seen exactly straight head-on, full roof, both mirrors, grille, tyres and bumper visible. The car is the clear main subject, bilaterally symmetric and centered at 50% of the canvas width. Use a landscape 3:2 canvas, with the main vehicle about 50% of the canvas width and 75% of its height. At the lower left, place one small realistic cargo ship with a restrained stack of shipping containers; at the lower right, one small neutral grey/red shipping container. Each logistics detail is no more than 20% of the total canvas width and 30% of the vehicle height. Clear transparent separation from the car, all objects on the same tyre baseline. The vehicle must be visually much more prominent than its supporting objects.
Style: detailed automotive studio photography with soft cool-white edge highlights that make the black car readable against a deep red or graphite website banner. Genuine transparent alpha background; tight soft contact shadows only, no solid ground plane.
Constraints: preserve recognizable G-Class shape, natural front-view proportions and black finish. Do not use a side profile or a three-quarter vehicle angle. No scene, ocean, warehouse, scenery, vignette, rectangle, gradient backdrop, text, labels, watermarks or UI. No extra cars. Do not copy the side-profile pose from Image 1.
